title: C01-C12 target entity and bridge schemas
description: Target-only schemas. Cross-record constraints are enforced by services/DB constraints, never this JSON schema alone.

x-service-invariants: pricing_configuration and method_policy are read-only value projections of this line's unique MethodPolicySelection; neither is a separately editable rule copy.
payment_term_id resolves to a warranty PaymentTerm in the same organization and contract line; warranty value is a subset of that included payment, never an additional charge.
Each warranty gross_cents and the aggregate warranties for one payment term must not exceed that payment term's gross_cents.
Each approved contract line has exactly one immutable approved selection; pricing_configuration is its unique complete approved rule snapshot.

policy_version is a server-derived PolicyVersion value projected from this selection's id/version/status/selected_on/approved_by_member_id and its approval audit, never an independently editable configuration.
Every milestone belongs to the approved parent contract line/project; from<to and ranges never overlap active accepted coverage.
Price is deterministic from approved milestone allocation and cumulative accepted range; no inference from attachment or entered amount.

Timesheet.x-legacy-adapter: Old Timesheet keeps original table/id/project/cost snapshot; adapter projects target_kind=project without historical rewrite.
x-service-invariants: Approval can preserve real minutes as unpriced when no approved rate/policy exists; display a cost gap, never assume zero.
Old dates keep original snapshots/line amounts. New dates use grouped provisional cumulative calculation from approved pool/rate inputs, then same-origin month reconciliation.

SalaryPool.x-unique-key: one active original pool per organization+employee+month; policy/version changes require linked correction, never another full cost source
x-service-invariants: Approve verified salary components/total once as company cost, initially unallocated; missing capacity blocks project distribution, not preservation of known wage facts.
allocation_inputs is null until complete server snapshot; project totals disclose unallocated coverage instead of claiming complete cost.
Components in immutable allocation snapshot are resolved from original pool version; no separate editable total/policy.
A planned full-month salary pool is an approved rate/forecast basis, not a full-month company cost posting.
Only incurred amounts for confirmed coverage through <=current business date can be company cost; disclose provisional versus reconciled actual.

Interim approved-minute estimates and final payroll use the same organization/employee/month labor origin. Final adjustment posts target cumulative cost minus already-effective cost, never adds full payroll on top.

New monthly labor policies bind employee/coverage and real independent approval; missing capacity is false/null, never zero. Later confirmed capacity is a new immutable policy with the same approved salary origin.

counterparty_id.description: Derived only when payee.kind=counterparty; employee payables reference Employee directly.

x-service-invariants: Scope/payee derive from approved obligation source. Payable source expense/spend acceptance may be project or nonproject without a customer contract.
Receivable scope is project with approved customer contract line. Same-source obligation is created once; no duplicate cost or management revenue.

counterparty_id.description: Derived only when payee.kind=counterparty; employee payables reference Employee directly.

x-service-invariants: Direction/scope/payee/date and partition amounts are inherited from approved Settlement, never a caller override.
Customer receivables have project scope and approved contract evidence; nonproject expense payables preserve original nonproject scope/employee payee.
Create all declared due/retention partitions once using stable source/partition keys; sum cannot exceed approved settlement. No duplicate cost/revenue/cash.

counterparty_id.description: Derived for external counterparty only; employee uses direct Employee id.

CashClassification.x-unique-key: Historical identity is organization_id + classification stable id; at most one effective classification per organization + cash stable id. Effective excludes only classifications with a valid full append-only reversal; retain all originals and reversals.

counterparty_id.description: Derived for external counterparty only; employee uses direct Employee id.

TimesheetBillableConfirmation.x-alias-only: One canonical relationship; no extra table or writable view.

CostAllocation.x-alias-only: One canonical relationship; no extra table or writable view.

ClearanceBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

AdvanceOffset.x-alias-only: One canonical relationship; no extra table or writable view.

CashAllocationBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

InvoiceAllocationBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

PerformanceSettlementMatchBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

ForecastCoverageBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

OpeningCoverageBridge.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

member-project-scope.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

membership-employee-binding.x-alias-only: Same logical record/projection; do not create another table or maintenance UI.

Membership.x-legacy-adapter: Same existing Membership ID; optimistic version via approved migration or immutable audit revision, not cloned account.

x-service-invariants: Constructed by trusted cash application only under company lock/current transaction; settlement verifies context/project/payee/versions and both limits.
Never deserialize from JSON, persist as a second balance, expose to personal AI or treat model text as authorization.
Verified business scope must equal the open item scope, including explicit nonproject destination; no synthetic project needed for employee reimbursement.

SourceConsumption.x-unique-key: organization+consumer+source.namespace+source.kind+source.id+coverage_key; excludes mutable source.version and caller channel/key
x-service-invariants: Coverage key comes from validated business range/period/line, never an arbitrary caller nonce.
Versions resolve immutable inputs; changed versions do not permit full reposting. Corrections append linked delta/reversal and coverage release.

Stable id/version identifies the immutable original claim. Effective consumed/released coverage is derived from linked append-only accounting events; an adjustment reuses original claim and cannot create a second claim for the same business key.

Monthly labor recognition and distribution use distinct employee/month coverage keys. Exclude covered_through/version/channel/request/run IDs; immutable original claim is reused after exact append-only release. Zero amount does not imply release: original event reversal, terminal salary state and unique active run remain authoritative.

PayrollCashLink.x-unique-key: organization_id + classification stable id + cash_transaction stable id + salary_pool stable id + payment_component; historical row key excludes reference versions and request/idempotency keys

CashClassificationReversal.x-unique-key: organization_id + original classification stable id; each original payroll link reversed at most once

InternalTransferReversal.x-unique-key: organization_id + original internal transfer stable id; excludes request key/version

x-cross-record-constraints: global lock order and atomic transaction
